description: Hardware identity of the AEFI device — single source of truth. Covers: source geometry, DDS-to-sphere wiring, excitation mode phases, sensor calibration, ADC channel mapping. DO NOT duplicate any of these values elsewhere in code or notes.

_changelog.v3.0: Complete rewrite. Fixed chip name swap (AD9106=DDS, ADS131A04=ADC). Removed incorrect 'S1=x+' axis convention (see _naming_warning). Added scan_frame_quadrant and full DDS wiring table. Added excitation_modes with per-sphere phase table. Sources: correspondance note 2025-06-12, position_visualizer.py, adapter_excitation_configuration_ad9106.py.

_naming_warning.Si_labels: S1–S4 are the labels of the 4 physical connectors on the amplification board (board silkscreen: DDS1–DDS4). They identify an electronic output, NOT a spatial axis. S1 is NOT on the x+ axis. Any code or note that uses 'S1=x+', 'S2=x-', 'S3=y+', 'S4=y-' as pure-axis positions is incorrect and must be corrected. Use scan_frame_quadrant for spatial reference.
_naming_warning.DDS_name_collision: The term 'DDS' is overloaded: (1) AD9106 chip generator channels (AD9106_CH1, AD9106_CH2) set via the adapter; (2) board output connector labels (DDS1–DDS4 printed on the PCB). These are DIFFERENT things. This config uses 'AD9106_CHx' for the chip channels and 'Si' for board connectors/spheres.
_naming_warning.source: 0_inbox/a-relire-et-renforcer-avant-integration/Notes volantes/ImagerieElectrique - Correspondance Poupette Sortie DDS - Connexion Carte Amplification Excitation.md (2025-06-12)

sources_geometry._ref: config_templates/NOTE - Source Frame Geometry.md — coordinate system and Distance Geometry Problem for pairwise distances.

sphere_labels._note: Quadrant convention (2026-07-24, corrects the earlier x+/x-/y+/y- half-axis labeling). S_i occupies a quadrant, not a half-axis. board_connector maps Si to the physical DDS output on the excitation board. Source of truth: 'ImagerieElectrique - Correspondance Poupette Sortie DDS - Connexion Carte Amplification Excitation' and the 'NOTE - Source Frame Geometry' (Luis Saluden's vault, not tracked in this repo).

sphere_diameters._note: Diameter phi_i (m) per sphere, measured individually at the caliper 2026-07-24 (mesures-dgp-pied-a-coulisse-4spheres). Sphere centers are not physically accessible to the caliper, so this and pairwise_distances_ext below are what's actually measured; center-to-center distances (r_i = phi_i/2, d_ij = D_ij - r_i - r_j) are derived in code, not stored here. uncertainty.expanded = U = k*u_c (GUM) for a single reading at the instrument resolution (0.02mm vernier, u_c = res/(2*sqrt(3))).

pairwise_distances_ext._note: 6 extremity-to-extremity distances D_ij (m), measured at the caliper 2026-07-24 (mesures-dgp-pied-a-coulisse-4spheres): the caliper spans the outer extremities of the two spheres, i.e. D_ij = center-to-center + r_i + r_j. Center-to-center distance is derived in code as d_ij = D_ij - r_i - r_j, not stored here. uncertainty.expanded as above (single caliper reading, 0.02mm vernier resolution).

electronics._note_chip: AD9106 = 4-channel DDS signal generator (TI). NOT ADS131A04 (which is the ADC). Old schema v2.0 had these chips swapped — this is the corrected version.

ad9106_channel_roles._note: AD9106 chip channels. CH1 and CH2 are the two independent excitation generators. CH3 and CH4 produce synchronous detection reference signals and are NEVER modified by the excitation adapter.

output_to_sphere_wiring._note: Physical wiring: each board connector (Si) receives a specific signal from one AD9106 channel or its complement. 'CHx_bar' means the complementary (inverted) output of AD9106_CHx. Source: correspondance note 2025-06-12.
output_to_sphere_wiring._board_photo: De gauche à droite sur la carte : DDS4, DDS3, DDS2, DDS1 (connecteurs physiques vers poupettes).

S1._meaning: Complement of CH2 = CH2 signal phase-shifted by 180°

S3._meaning: Complement of CH1 = CH1 signal phase-shifted by 180°

max_excitation_gain_raw.description: Practical maximum AD9106 gain register value (100% level). Limited by amplification board saturation. Hardware absolute max is 16376.

excitation_modes._note: Phase register: 16-bit, 0=0°, 16384=90°, 32768=180°, 49152=270°. AD9106_CH1 phase is always 0° (reference). AD9106_CH3 and CH4 are never touched. 'Phase at sphere' is derived from wiring: CHx → sphere gets CHx phase; CHx_bar → sphere gets CHx phase + 180°.

X_DIR.field_effect: x<0 spheres (S1, S4) positive, x>0 spheres (S2, S3) negative → electric field gradient along X axis.

Y_DIR.field_effect: y<0 spheres (S2, S4) positive, y>0 spheres (S1, S3) negative → electric field gradient along Y axis.

CIRCULAR_PLUS.field_effect: CH2 leads CH1 by 90°. Rotating field. Rotation sense (CW/CCW) to be confirmed experimentally.

CIRCULAR_MINUS.field_effect: CH2 lags CH1 by 90°. Rotating field opposite sense to CIRCULAR_PLUS.

dimension.description: Characteristic size of the sensor cube

z_offset.description: Z distance from the source plane to the center of the sensor

adc._note_chip: ADS131A04 = 4-channel simultaneous 24-bit ADC (TI). NOT AD9106 (which is the DDS). Old schema v2.0 had these chips swapped — this is the corrected version.

channels._note: Logical channel assignment for lock-in demodulated sensor signals. Each of the 3 sensor axes produces real (in-phase I) and imaginary (quadrature Q) components.
